name: com.setnet.locomotion
description: A client-side NavAgent component for SetNet games: feed it a path (that you computed with SetNet.PathFinding from a destination point the server sent) and it moves the GameObject along it at a Speed you set (your replicated move-speed stat). The server stays authoritative — it sends only the destination; the client re-paths locally and NavAgent walks the model. UPM source, UnityEngine-only, no SetNet assembly required at runtime.
